locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; even zero-integral sources, the actual source Gram, and the source normalization are retained
locked_conventions.physical_interval: [-log(lambda),log(lambda)] with L=2*log(lambda), logarithmic Lebesgue measure, and zero extension
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(x)*exp(-i*t*x)dx with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi); e_t(x)=exp(i*t*x)
locked_conventions.inversion: J is physical reflection x->-x; a finite additive-Fourier residue class is not substituted for inversion parity
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained at the inclusive endpoint, and lambda is never confused with lambda^2
locked_conventions.right_inverse_gauge: only P_H*T*(I-P_F)*B*P_V is intrinsic; the raw norm of (I-P_F)*B*P_V depends on the ker(T) intersect F^perp gauge
locked_conventions.corrected_sparse_space: F=E intersect 1^perp with P_F formed from the actual corrected source Gram; both omitted prolate residues and the rank-one mean correction remain
locked_conventions.spectral_endpoints: upper layer estimates use 1_(sigma,1](C); lower/converse estimates use 1_[sigma,1](C)
locked_conventions.strictness: a big-O scale, equality at a required strict threshold, rank alone, or a nonpositive reserve is not a pass
locked_conventions.input_text: lambda numerator and decimal precision are canonical positive integer text; binary64 inputs and JSON numbers are rejected
locked_conventions.input_limits: producer and verifier admit only lambda_numerator in {5,9} and dps in {80,160}; exact text membership is checked before integer conversion or interval initialization
locked_conventions.runtime_version: the interval runtime must report mpmath==1.4.1 exactly; a mismatch is rejected before any interval probe
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact quotient, cross-Gram, layer-cake, endpoint, directional-moment, and rational countermodel diagnostics; no actual physical feature angle, exterior layer alignment, odd reserve, or asymptotic theorem is certified
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms, prime-power sums, support radii, Taylor tails, and optimal moment constants use outward mpmath.iv intervals

locked_formulas.transformed_tail: P_H*P_V=P_H*T*(I-P_F)*B*P_V for every right inverse T*B=I
locked_formulas.minimum_source_tail: with A=P_H*T restricted to F^perp and Y=P_H*P_V, epsilon_min=norm(A^dagger*Y)
locked_formulas.corrected_sparse_coefficients: ||(I-P_F)z||^2=sum_(n notin S)|z_n|^2+|sum_(n notin S) conjugate(I_n)*z_n|^2/s for z perpendicular to 1 and s=sum_(n in S)|I_n|^2
locked_formulas.physical_graph_bound: if M=U^*W is square and invertible, Z=W*M^(-1)*G and beta=||(I-P_V)Z*G^(-1/2)|| imply alpha_V<=beta/sqrt(1+beta^2)
locked_formulas.exact_layer_cake: D_ext=integral_0^A_star C_s ds with C_s=T_(1_{|t|>delta/L and m_lambda(t)<U+nu*L-s}) restricted to X
locked_formulas.dyadic_majorant: a0=min(A_star,tau), J=ceil(log2(A_star/tau)), s_j=2^j*tau, c_j=min(A_star,2^(j+1)*tau)-s_j, and D_ext<=a0*I+sum_j c_j*C_(s_j)
locked_formulas.odd_reserve: B_r=(alpha_r*sqrt(S_L)+epsilon_p_r)^2<h/2, h=(a-beta)*L, implies a strict beta*L odd floor; B_r<=(1-eta)*h/2 gives shifted floor eta*h
locked_formulas.odd_source_constant: (lambda^(3/2)*epsilon_FV/2+epsilon_p_r)^2<(a-beta)*L/2 is sufficient, while the intrinsic constant target is limsup lambda*alpha_r^2/L<a-beta
locked_formulas.optimal_moment_remainder: U_k-load <= 2*mu_p/h*C_k(gamma), C_0=gamma, C_k=max_(0<=x<=gamma) x^k*(gamma-x)/(1-x); for k>=1 x_k=(A_k-sqrt(A_k^2-4*k^2*gamma))/(2*k), A_k=(k+1)+(k-1)*gamma
locked_formulas.claim_separation: a logarithmic number of full-rank layer projectors is not a logarithmic-dimensional capture theorem, and neither finite fixtures nor source-gauge tails prove the actual physical alignments
